# fvipers (Fighting Vipers, Revision D; Model 2B-CRX): entry points the
# recompiler cannot find by itself. The MAME harvest (scripts/run_trace.sh's
# branches.txt: the targets of indirect branches, calls and balx, the interrupt
# handlers and the IAC target) over attract (9,000 frames), a scripted fight and
# a test-mode walk (MAME -nodrc); the interrupted addresses are not seeds. Addresses
# only (our own analysis; rules.md rule 7).
# scripts/seed_scan.py
# Stubs (lda/shlo/mov imm,g0; b T) entered through computed pointers, as VF2's
# script stubs: every one whose branch target T is shared by two or more (an
# i960dis scan of the program ROM, 19 Oct 2026: 0x1eb8c 92, 0x4a674 11, ...).
